Customer Obsession.example: I started from what the merchant needed and worked backwards from the customer to the design.
The delayed payouts were the biggest customer pain point, so I fixed that first.

Customer Obsession.en: close the loop with the customer
Customer Obsession.example: I closed the loop with the customer to confirm the fix actually solved their problem.

Ownership.example: I took end-to-end ownership of the pipeline, from design to on-call.

Ownership.en: it wasn't my job, but it needed doing
Ownership.zh: 不是我的职责但必须有人做
Ownership.example: It wasn't my job, but it needed doing, so I picked it up.
When the outage hit, the buck stopped with me.

Invent and Simplify.example: I cut through the complexity by replacing three steps with one command.
I removed moving parts so there was less that could break.
Rather than patch it, I reinvented the approach with a much simpler model.

Are Right, A Lot.zh: 在模糊情况下做出可靠判断
Are Right, A Lot.example: I showed sound judgment under ambiguity by choosing the option with the reversible downside.
I sought out disconfirming evidence before committing to the plan.

Are Right, A Lot.en: make a call with incomplete data
Are Right, A Lot.example: I had to make a call with incomplete data and wrote down my assumptions.

Learn and Be Curious.example: I got up to speed quickly on a stack I had never touched.
The project stretched me outside my comfort zone, which is why I took it.
I went down the rabbit hole on the protocol until I understood the failure.

Hire and Develop the Best.example: I wanted every new hire to raise the bar for the team.
I coached the new engineer through the gap in system design.
I gave them stretch work so they could grow into the role.

Insist on the Highest Standards.example: I held a high bar on tests even when the deadline was tight.
I didn't just patch it, I fixed the class of problem.

Insist on the Highest Standards.zh: 还没到可以交付的水平
Insist on the Highest Standards.example: I told the team it was not good enough yet and showed the gap.

Think Big.example: I proposed a bold direction: one platform for every research team.
I thought beyond the immediate problem and designed for ten times the load.
I set an ambitious vision and broke it into milestones.

Bias for Action.en: move fast on a reversible decision
Bias for Action.zh: 对可逆的决定快速行动
Bias for Action.example: It was a two-way door, so I moved fast and adjusted later.
I took a calculated risk and shipped behind a flag.
I didn't wait for perfect information because the cost of delay was higher.

Frugality.example: I did more with less by reusing the existing job instead of building a new service.
Constraints breed resourcefulness, so I used a ten-line script.
I avoided over-engineering and shipped the simplest thing that worked.

Earn Trust.example: I was upfront about the mistake in the postmortem.
I built credibility with the other team by sharing data early.
I told my manager early so there would be no surprises.

Dive Deep.example: I got into the weeds of the query plan to find the real cause.

Dive Deep.en: trace it back to the root cause
Dive Deep.example: I traced it back to the root cause instead of treating the symptom.
I let the data speak and pulled the logs before forming a theory.

Have Backbone; Disagree and Commit.zh: 礼貌但坚定地提出异议
Have Backbone; Disagree and Commit.example: I respectfully pushed back on the timeline and brought numbers.
I voiced a dissenting view in the review, then listened to the reasoning.
Once the decision was made, I fully committed and helped it succeed.

Deliver Results.example: I landed the project two days ahead of the audit date.
I hit the deadline despite a late schema change.
The change moved the needle on settlement accuracy.

Strive to be Earth's Best Employer.example: I worked to build psychological safety so juniors felt free to ask questions.
I wrote an onboarding doc to set new joiners up for success.
I tried to create an inclusive environment where every voice was heard in design reviews.

Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibi.example: I considered unintended consequences before rolling the change out to all merchants.

Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibi.en: leave it better than I found it
Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibi.zh: 让事物比我接手时更好
Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibi.example: I wanted to leave the system better than I found it for the next team.
I thought about the downstream impact on finance and support teams.
